0022600019.text: The Toronto Raptors (2-1, 3rd in the Atlantic and 5th in the East, with a 1-0 home record and a 1-game losing streak) host the Orlando Magic (1-2, 4th in the Southeast and 10th in the East, on a 1-game winning streak). Toronto is without Brandon Ingram (Achilles, surgery), Kawhi Leonard (knee, inflammation), and Nate Bittle (foot, fracture), while Orlando is without Izaiyah Nelson (ankle, surgery), Jalen Suggs (knee), Jonathan Isaac (knee), Noah Penda (hamstring, strain), and Paolo Banchero (ankle, sprain). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, but the Raptors won the 2025-26 season series 2-1, including a 139-87 win in Toronto on March 29, 2026.
